calibration.assembly: Factory-only soldering and socket population; factory adjustment through accessible test points.
calibration.pitch_tracking_scope: 0..5 V at 25 C after factory calibration; target only, not guaranteed by resistor tolerance. #29 defines sweep and temperature characterization.
calibration.pitch_voltage_error_caveat: 5 cents at 1 V/oct equals 4.166667 mV; oscillator exponential/core error and temperature must share this total budget. A 2 mV octave-step target alone does not prove five-octave tracking.
calibration.sample_hold: No long-hold pitch accuracy promise; characterize droop separately from output load error.

oscillator_calibration.intent_en: Use existing rear-accessible trimmers for individual oscillator calibration; final playing pitch is manually tuned by the user.
oscillator_calibration.owner_quote_ja: オシレーターは、一般的には後ろ側とかにあるpotentiometer で基本音階なんかを調整し、厳密なピッチ調整は最後人の手でとなっているかと思うので、多分そんな感じで良いと思う。おそらく部品個体差もあるとおもうので、それをら調整する役割として後ろ側のpotentiometer が用意されることが多い
oscillator_calibration.rear_access: Existing rear-core allocation and tool reservations retained; physical access not qualified
oscillator_calibration.scope: O1-O5 family intent; exact inspected candidate instance O1; no replication, calibration or hardware change

physical_and_order_readiness: OPEN; exact identity closure is not rating/process/assembly qualification

pot_disposition.reason: Keep current/response unchanged; initial loaded knob law is not an accuracy failure.

clipping_headroom_and_recovery.method: Source sum/headroom screen and later extreme-combination/recovery characterization.
clipping_headroom_and_recovery.requirement: Retain +/-5V contribution ranges and nominal +/-10V internal clip indication; +/-15V algebra is not a realizable +/-12V-powered output. Recover from overrange without latch-up.

electrical_safety.method: Review exact limits and conditional fault states; later controlled test using approved safety procedure.
electrical_safety.requirement: Retain protection, device ratings, power/thermal, missing-rail/backfeed and output fault obligations; coarse precision grants no safety waiver.
electrical_safety.source: Stage22 role/rating analysis; unchanged global protection contracts

manufacturing_and_assembly.method: Use dated receipts and source definitions; subsequent process/fit qualification is not waived.
manufacturing_and_assembly.requirement: Exact sourcing, footprint/pad/mask/paste, component profiles, DIN position/fixing and externally completed wiring remain gates.

noise_and_control_artifacts.method: Later listen/measure with quiet inputs and representative audio/CV patches; record signal-relative noise and objectionable artifacts, not a new unsupported mV threshold.
noise_and_control_artifacts.requirement: Assess hum, hiss, pickup, wiper noise and audible/control modulation after setting and during motion; do not treat arbitrary noise as acceptable.

practical_settling.method: Nominal RC diagnostic plus later real control steps/movement under bias, component tolerance and harness loads. No new tight settling deadline.
practical_settling.requirement: Retain1kohm/10Mohm/10nF manual filter; assess response without prolonged lag or ringing and without removing useful noise filtering.
practical_settling.source: Existing manual filter, owner coarse utility use

sensible_loading.method: Source load/current ledger and later same-setting load sweep; observe range/headroom/current/thermal and musically material sag.
sensible_loading.requirement: Retain nominal100kohm protected inputs and existing output sensing/isolation. Report output change open/100k/10k without the retired A-cell1mV precision gate.
sensible_loading.source: Existing minimum10kohm load envelope; owner coarse utility interpretation

stable_operation.method: Later actual loop/load and startup characterization; no stability pass from static arithmetic.
stable_operation.requirement: No sustained oscillation; preserve current compensation and assess actual harness, capacitive/resistive loads and startup.

useful_control_range.method: Source polarity/range check and later full-travel sweep in both directions; observe usable endpoints and center.
useful_control_range.requirement: Retain continuous no-detent OFFSET, intended bipolar manual range, ATTEN inversion/zero/positive behavior and independent CV addition. No fixed shaft-position accuracy promise.
useful_control_range.source: Owner use; retained A01 function and Stage15 no-detent decision

precision_output_load_error_V.authority: Engineering interpretation of coarse utility scope: retire precision numeric load acceptance, retain loading and stability checks

static_precision_error_V.authority: Explicit owner relaxation of blanket calibrated static precision
static_precision_error_V.origin: OSC-ES-1 owner-delegated engineering proposal, not an original owner numeric requirement
